source_population: Home Credit application_test.csv with frozen CrediFast artifacts

profiles.label: Good record, full history
profiles.description: Has borrowed before and repaid on time. We hold all four kinds of past record.
profiles.demo_intent: Show the standard evidence-rich review route.

profiles.label: Borderline · needs judgement
profiles.description: Full history, but the estimate sits right on the line between two grades.
profiles.demo_intent: Show boundary-aware manual review without changing the probability.

profiles.label: Partial history
profiles.description: Some past records are missing, so the estimate leans partly on the application form.
profiles.demo_intent: Show validated model disagreement and data-limited routing.

profiles.label: New to credit
profiles.description: No past borrowing record at all. The hardest case to assess, and a common one.
profiles.demo_intent: Show visible uncertainty and mandatory data-limited review.

profiles.label: Poor repayment record
profiles.description: Full history available, and it shows a high chance of difficulty repaying.
profiles.demo_intent: Show adverse evidence without presenting an autonomous decline.

profiles.label: Repayment stretched
profiles.description: The good applicant above, but asked to repay far more each year.
profiles.demo_intent: Show that affordability can change while historical risk evidence remains separate.

profiles.label: Records unavailable
profiles.description: A test of what happens when past records cannot be read at all.
profiles.demo_intent: Show explicit pipeline-quality flags and fail-closed review routing.
